helpful: The provisioned petition, BIO, and QP text were sufficient to form the forecast; the BIO's circuit survey did most of the work.
context.json's frozen band plus the sal-v4 segment table gave an unambiguous anchor.
gaps: CourtListener MCP hit the upstream 300/hour rate limit on the second call of the cell; a shared quota across concurrent cells in a fan-out means late cells get little or no live retrieval.

fedcourts query with --court scotus --era 2020s --disposition granted/denied returned mostly 26A application dockets despite the default application screen, so it did not surface comparable paid cert petitions; a filter on docket form (paid cert only) or on originating court for SCOTUS rows would help.
No way to check for pending merits cases on a topic (hold candidates) without live CourtListener access.
notes: Two of three MCP calls failed with HTTP 429; proceeded on provisioned inputs and the statpack per the prompt's degraded-upstream rule.
